_comment: The browser-harness MCP server, spawned over stdio. `python` resolves from PATH, so run `claude` with the harness's virtualenv activated (or point this at your interpreter). Prefer that over an absolute path: an absolute path that does not exist on the machine reading this file makes the server fail to launch, and a failed stdio server does not stop the session — the agent simply runs with none of the browser tools. runtime.cli is immune (runtime/options.py falls back to sys.executable when the configured command is not an existing file); the `claude` CLI reads this file directly and is not.
